items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: No, no, no, I don't think so. No. No relation at all. He's a fine piano player.

ctx.x: Did she have any other special numbers that you remember?

She did. She did. Well that was, I tell you Bill, that was one reason my dad had told me, you know, go out and get some experience, you know, like for reading. He really wanted me to do it the right way. But after we run down the show, they had music. After we run down, most of them, Miss Cox had music. Well after about a couple of weeks or so, well I mean I was memorizing the music and I mean I didn't need it much. I wasn't advancing at all too much.
